### How to Live the Bible — God Brings Restoration
Author: Mel Lawrenz
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2022/02/how-to-live-the-bible-god-brings-restoration/
Passage: Leviticus 25:3-5
Points:
- Just as soil pushed to exhaustion becomes barren, land and people alike need intentional rest to regain strength.
- George Washington Carver's agricultural work illustrated how giving exhausted ground rest and replenishment brings renewed life.
- God’s Sabbath rhythms remind believers of their ongoing need for healing, justice, and release from life's burdens.
- Resting requires letting go of nonstop striving and acknowledging that God alone is God.
- Eliminating unnecessary busyness creates space to be still and receive the Lord's restorative care.
